Routes around Vancouver#

You don’t have to plan from scratch. These rides run through Vancouver or pass close by, mapped and written up by route publishers around BC. The full maps and turn-by-turns live on their sites.

  1. Trans Canada Bike Route (BC Only) — Trans Canada Bike Route Network · 5,446 km route, 53 km of it through Vancouver
  2. Vancouver Crossing Loop — Adventure Cycling Association · 503 km route, 40 km of it through Vancouver
  3. Cherry Blossom Populaire — British Columbia Randonneurs · 102 km route, 35 km of it through Vancouver
  4. Trans Canada Trail South (BC Only) — Trans Canada Trail · 1,768 km route, 31 km of it through Vancouver
  5. Seaside Greenway — Let's Go Biking · 24 km, all of it in Vancouver
  6. Ridgeway Loop — Let's Go Biking · 24 km route, 22 km of it through Vancouver
  7. Vancouver City Circle — Let's Go Biking · 20 km, all of it in Vancouver
  8. Queen Elizabeth Park Loop — Let's Go Biking · 20 km, all of it in Vancouver
  9. Harbour Loop — Let's Go Biking · 30 km route, 17 km of it through Vancouver
  10. Great Northern Bikepacking Route, BC Part One — Great Northern Bikepacking Route · 583 km route, 16 km of it through Vancouver

We’re showing the 10 that cover the most ground here. Another 47 come through or near Vancouver. See every ride in Vancouver, Coast and Mountains →
